content.name: Sneha Reddy
content.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
content.summary: Digital marketing specialist with two and a half years' experience in performance marketing for D2C and edtech brands in Bengaluru. Manages ₹9 lakh a month in Google and Meta ads for a test-prep platform and reduced cost per paid enrolment by 26% through Kannada and Telugu ad variants.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Run Google Search, YouTube and Meta campaigns worth ₹9 lakh a month for an online test-prep platform for state engineering entrance exams.
Launched regional-language ad variants in Kannada and Telugu that lowered cost per paid enrolment from ₹1,850 to ₹1,370.
Set up WhatsApp Business follow-ups for webinar sign-ups with the counselling team, raising webinar-to-trial conversion from 12% to 19%.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Executive
bullets: Managed Instagram and Meta ads for a D2C herbal skincare brand, scaling monthly website orders from 1,100 to 2,600.
Coordinated 35 micro-influencer collaborations with tracked coupon codes, identifying eight creators who drove 70% of influencer sales.
Maintained product listings and sponsored ads on two marketplaces, improving average listing rating from 3.9 to 4.3.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Intern
bullets: Created reels and posts for a cloud kitchen brand, growing Instagram followers from 4,200 to 9,800 in ten weeks.
Tracked food delivery app offers against order volumes in a weekly Excel report for the founder.
Wrote Google Business Profile updates that increased direct calls for bulk orders.

education.details: CGPA 8.4/10. Final-year project on regional-language advertising response among first-time online shoppers.

courses.name: Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Professional Certificate

achievements.title: College fest marketing lead
achievements.detail: Led social media for the university cultural fest, reaching 1.2 lakh accounts in two weeks.
